out

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / N8 160368830
Charger ID/Serial No.
: wq9QKF
Problem Description
:
Unable to rollout FW 4.0.11
Troubleshooting
:
I have reviewed the case history for this asset, and the charger was previously on firmware version 4.0.11 following the onsite intervention. However, the charger is now running on firmware version 3.2.8. As you mentioned during our conversation on MS Teams, you are also unaware of when this downgrade occurred. Therefore, we will need some time to investigate when and how the charger downgraded to firmware version 3.2.8.
For future reference, your case number is
0397829
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: 0397829 - ID0397829-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N8 160368830]  Unable to rollout FW 4.0.11 CRM:02023000392
additional_info.body:
Hi Sadek,
Happy new year,
Upon checking the logs from Nov 2024 till date, it appears like the charger was never running on v4.0.11, the version was 3.2.8 since Nov 2024.
There was a typo error in the previous ticket closure.
We are now investigating together with the ES team, why the roll-out for V4.0.11 is not possible, we will try to resolve it remotely.
If that's not possible, I am afraid that a site visit will be required to manually update the FW via CFAST or USB.
You will soon hear from us.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
